name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

files.content:
Class form, single

class="np-accordion". Items that share a name open one at a time.

What are your shipping options?
We offer standard (5-7 days), express (2-3 days), and overnight shipping. Free shipping on international orders.
What is your return policy?

Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

See the full policy for exceptions.

How can I contact customer support?
Reach us by email, live chat, or phone. We respond within 24 hours on business days.

Data-attribute form

data-np-accordion and data-np-accordion-*, no classes.

Is it accessible?
Yes. It uses the native disclosure element, so keyboard and screen reader support come from the browser.
Is it styled?
Yes. It comes with styles that match the rest of nepui.

Multiple

Leave out name and any number can be open.

Notification Settings
Manage how you receive notifications.
Privacy & Security
Control your privacy settings and security preferences.
Billing & Subscription
View your current plan and download past invoices.

Disabled

data-disabled on the item, plus tabindex="-1" and aria-disabled="true" on the summary so the keyboard skips it.

Can I access my account history?
Yes, from the account page.
Premium feature information
Premium features.
How do I update my email address?
Open your profile settings and choose Email.

Bordered

np-accordion-bordered or data-variant="bordered".

How does billing work?
We offer monthly and annual subscription plans. Billing is charged at the beginning of each cycle, and you can cancel anytime.
Is my data secure?
Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
What integrations do you support?
Slack, GitHub, Google Workspace, and Zapier.

Custom icon

Swap --np-accordion-icon (any url() mask) and set --np-accordion-icon-rotate-open to 0deg for an icon that does not rotate.

A plus that turns into a cross
The icon rotates 45 degrees.
Another item
More content.
